study.name: iot4cows
study.description: Capacity of a single-gateway LoRaWAN network for collar-mounted cattle monitoring over an 88.54 ha grazing area.
study.path_loss_source: Field fit over 1,229 aggregated RSSI points, 30 m to 2.21 km, IoT4Cows deployment

provenance.description: Where the gateway stops delivering more traffic. Capacity is where the DER falls below the threshold, a requirement on the share delivered. Past it the network still delivers more messages per hour for a while, until losses grow faster than the traffic offered. The grid is carried on to 3000 nodes to find that peak, under the study's own receiver rule, capture threshold and orthogonal spreading factors.
